thought: He gave private tuitions in Prayagraj to support his family. In 2026, Forbes put him on its billionaires list.
support: Alakh Pandey started out teaching private physics tuitions in Prayagraj to help support his family, before building a YouTube channel teaching the subject starting in 2014. In 2020, he co-founded PhysicsWallah, an edtech platform for students preparing for competitive exams like NEET and JEE. Following the company's IPO in November 2025, Pandey entered the Forbes World's Billionaires List in March 2026 - reported by multiple outlets as having surpassed Shah Rukh Khan on India's rich list. A tuition teacher who once taught one classroom at a time now runs a company reaching millions of students.
